hero.title: Buses between Ukraine and the Czech Republic
hero.text: Comfortable coaches from Kyiv, Lviv and western Ukraine to Prague, Brno, Ostrava and Pilsen — and back. Book online in a few minutes.

items.payment: Pay online or at the office

fleet.title: Our fleet
fleet.note: The fleet is illustrative: Busora is a demo company.

about.title: About Busora
about.lead: Busora runs regular coach services between Ukraine and the Czech Republic: two lines, four directions, thirteen cities. This website is an educational project that shows how a bus booking service works from search to ticket — the company itself is fictional.

why.title: Why travel with Busora
items: Direct buses without changes between Ukraine and Czechia.
Fixed timetables with departures on set weekdays.
Discounts for children, students, seniors and groups.
Tickets by email in Ukrainian, Czech or English.

howToBook.title: How to book a ticket
steps: Choose where you travel from and to, the date and the number of passengers.
Pick a bus and enter the passenger details.
Check the booking and pay online.
Download your tickets — they are also sent to your email.

border.title: Crossing the border
items: Ukrainian citizens with a biometric passport can stay in the EU visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period; holders of temporary protection follow their own rules.
Have your passport, ticket and, for children travelling without both parents, the required consent ready.
Border checks can take several hours, so arrival times are approximate.
Check customs limits for cash, tobacco, alcohol and food before you travel.

czechia.title: Travelling in the Czech Republic
czechia.text: Prague, Brno, Ostrava and Pilsen are linked by fast trains and buses, and city public transport is easy to use with contactless payment. The currency is the Czech koruna (CZK); cards are accepted almost everywhere.

routesPage.title: Bus routes
routesPage.intro: Every city pair we serve, with fares and the days buses depart. Choose a route to book.
routesPage.infoTitle: Travelling by bus between Ukraine and Czechia
info: A coach is the simplest way to travel between the two countries: no changes, generous baggage allowance and stops close to city centres.
Buses from Ukraine leave in the morning and arrive in the Czech Republic the next morning; return buses leave in the evening.

schedulePage.title: Timetable
schedulePage.note: Times are local. Arrival times are approximate and depend on the border crossing.

faresPage.title: Fares
faresPage.intro: Fares from Ukraine are in hryvnias (UAH), fares from the Czech Republic in korunas (CZK). Each cell shows one way / round trip.
faresPage.discountsNote: Personal discounts do not apply to promo tickets. Bring a document that proves the discount.
baggage: Included: 2 pieces up to 60 × 40 × 40 cm with a total weight of up to 50 kg, including up to 5 kg of hand luggage.
Children under 12: 1 piece up to 25 kg.
Extra baggage, if there is room: 50 Kč per kg, or the equivalent in UAH.

rulesPage.title: Carriage rules
rulesPage.intro: These rules are part of the public offer of Busora LLC, a fictional company of this educational project. They match the terms printed on every ticket.

general.title: General provisions
items: The passenger is responsible for complying with passport, visa, customs and migration rules.
Passengers under 18 travelling without parents need a notarised consent from the parents or guardians.
The carrier may refuse to carry a passenger who is drunk, clearly unwell in a way that endangers others, or behaves dangerously.
The carrier is not liable for delays caused by events beyond its control: weather, border queues, road works or actions of state authorities.
Complaints about the service are accepted in writing.

carrier.title: Carrier's duties
items: Provide the bus for boarding on time and depart according to the timetable.
Deliver passengers and their baggage to their destination.
Ensure safe carriage and good service on board.
Keep the bus in good technical and sanitary condition.
Give passengers accurate information about the trip.

passenger.title: Passenger's duties
items: Arrive for boarding no later than 30 minutes before departure.
Show a valid passport and, if travelling with a discount, the document that entitles to it.
Keep the ticket until the end of the trip and show it on request.
Have the visa and migration documents needed for the trip.
Return to the bus on time at stops along the route.
Keep the bus clean and treat its equipment with care.

rights.title: Passenger's rights
items: Safe and comfortable carriage.
Carriage of baggage within the allowance.
Information about the timetable, fares and rules.
A refund for an unused ticket under the terms below.

prohibited.title: Not allowed on board
items: Smoking, including electronic cigarettes.
Drinking alcohol.
Carrying dangerous, flammable or prohibited goods.
Disturbing other passengers or the driver.

tickets.title: Tickets
items: A ticket is personal and cannot be transferred to another person.
Promotional and open-date tickets are non-refundable.
An open-date return ticket is valid for 6 months from the first trip; the return can be made on any bus with free seats.
If a passenger breaks visa rules, the carrier may refuse carriage without refunding the ticket.

refunds.title: Refund for an unused ticket
refunds.text: If you cancel the trip, the ticket price is refunded minus a fee that depends on when you cancel:

baggage.title: Baggage
items: The ticket includes 2 pieces of baggage up to 60 × 40 × 40 cm with a total weight of up to 50 kg, including hand luggage up to 5 kg.
A child's ticket (under 12) includes 1 piece of baggage up to 25 kg.
Extra baggage is carried if there is room in the luggage hold, at 50 Kč per kg or the equivalent in UAH at the exchange rate on the day of payment.
Passengers and their baggage are insured for the trip (fictional insurer in this demo).
